# LaTeXShot 0.1.0

First printed-equation release for Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later.

Capture an equation with ⌘⇧L and copy its LaTeX using a configurable clipboard format. Recognition runs offline. Handwriting support is planned for a follow-up release.

This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. See the README's first-launch instructions.
